an8.71:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] saddho ca bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti, no ca sīlavā ,
an8.71:1.4: ‘kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā cā’ ti.
an8.71:1.5: yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca.
an8.71:2.1: saddho ca bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti, sīlavā ca no ca bahussuto
an8.71:2.4: “kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā ca bahussuto cā” ti.
an8.71:2.5: yato ca kho bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca bahussuto ca,
an8.71:3.1: saddho ca bhikkhave bhikkhu hoti, sīlavā ca bahussuto ca no ca dhammakathiko, …pe…
an8.71:3.3: parisāvacaro ca no ca visārado parisāya dhammaṃ deseti, …pe…
an8.71:3.4: visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti. no ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī …pe…
an8.71:3.5: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, no ca āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati,
an8.71:3.8: kintāhaṃ saddho ca assaṃ sīlavā ca bahussuto ca dhammakathiko ca parisāvacaro ca visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī assaṃ akicchalābhī akasiralābhī āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyanti.
an8.71:4.1: yato ca kho bhikkhave, bhikkhu saddho ca hoti sīlavā ca bahussuto ca dhammakathiko ca parisāvacaro ca visārado ca parisāya dhammaṃ deseti, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an8.71:4.3: imehi kho bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu samantapāsādiko ca hoti sabbākāraparipūro cāti.
